observations: Photo 0 shows a white PlayStation 5 Slim console with the PS logo visible on the top panel. A white and black DualSense controller is placed in front of it, along with a power cable and a manual labeled 'PlayStation5' with Chinese text. The console appears to be in a box or wrapped.

Photo 1 shows the same console from a different angle, with the DualSense controller beside it. The console has a glossy white top and a matte white bottom. The PS logo is visible on the top panel. The console is placed on a white cloth or plastic wrap. The console appears to be in a box or wrapped.
The console in both photos is white, consistent with the 'Slim' model. The controller is white and black, matching the DualSense design.
The manual in photo 0 has 'PlayStation5' and Chinese text, suggesting it is a non-English version or a regional edition. The console's design matches the PS5 Slim model.
No FIFA disc game is visible in either photo. The seller claims it comes with a FIFA disc game, but it is not shown.

risks.risk: The console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine unit.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the serial number and model label on the console, and a video of the console's system settings screen showing the correct model and firmware.

risks.risk: The FIFA disc game may not be included or may be damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the FIFA disc game and a video showing it being inserted and played.
